//: The end-to-end suite is not a workspace package - it is a directory at the root that
Playwright runs - so `turbo run typecheck` never reached it. It has its own config rather
than joining one of the apps' because it belongs to neither: it imports the web app's
dictionary and the shared package's types while running in Node under Playwright, with
Playwright's own globals. Every strictness flag comes from tsconfig.base.json unchanged -
`strict`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `verbatimModuleSyntax` - so a spec is held to what the
rest of the repository is held to.
